scope: P0 containment with North Star P1/P2 capability-state remediation
verifiedContracts: A server-owned pure policy resolves global and channel capability from typed idempotency, live-mode, provider-configuration, and contact-readiness signals.
The dispatch capability endpoint currently reports preview-only mode without invoking a provider.
The UI distinguishes checking, error, preview_only, and live states; only live can send.
Malformed and non-success capability responses render lookup failure and can be retried.
Unavailable states provide a channel-settings link and an explicit retry action.
Partial-live states retain channel-settings and retry actions whenever any channel remains blocked.
Email, SMS, and Kakao controls are disabled and do not retain active or pressed presentation.
Disabled channel accessible names contain the blocking reason and omit misleading next actions.
The primary action is disabled and labeled as preview-only until live capability is explicitly reported.
Share-session creation code and localized message preview paths remain present.
Recipient-facing copy describes language-specific preparation without claiming a portal, link, or recipient confirmation.
Browser tests observed zero share-session and workflow-dispatch POST requests in checking, error, and preview-only states.
A foreign-language preview selected during capability error remains selected and unchanged through retry, 405, and preview-only transitions.
excluded: Recipient portal or share-token route implementation
